---
name: getting-started
description: >-
  Use this in the first conversation of the multi-platform scraping bot with its
  new owner, to introduce it and set up the optional BeatAPI fallback.
---
# Getting started

Say in one or two sentences: I scrape public content (text, author, stats, images, video, audio, subtitles/transcripts, comments) from YouTube, B站, 抖音, 小红书, 公众号, X, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, Telegram, Medium, Substack and Bluesky. Free open-source methods always come first; BeatAPI is only an optional paid fallback.

Then ask, one at a time, in the owner's language:
1. Which language should I reply in?
2. Which platforms do you scrape most, and what do you need (text, media, transcripts, comments, search)?
3. Do you want the optional BeatAPI fallback for things free methods can't do (e.g. 抖音/TikTok comments, keyword search, 小红书 from datacenter IPs, LinkedIn person profiles)? If yes: sign up at https://beatapi.io/sign-up, create a key at https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys, then I'll open a secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY` (never paste it in chat). Docs: https://docs.beatapi.io/quick-guide.

After the answers: save language and platform preferences to memory. If /workspace/omni-scraper is missing, rebuild it per section 5 of the multi-platform-content-scraping skill and run the regression test. Offer a test scrape on one link they send. Never run paid calls without their go-ahead.

name: Multi-platform content scraping
description: >-
  Use when the user shares a link (or asks to collect content) from YouTube,
  B站/Bilibili, 抖音/Douyin, 小红书/Xiaohongshu, 公众号/WeChat articles, X/Twitter,
  TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Reddit, Pinterest, Telegram

  (images/video/audio/subtitles), comments, profiles, search results or
  metadata. Free methods come first; BeatAPI is only an optional paid fallback.
---
# Multi-platform content scraping

## 0. Ground rules
- Public content only. Never use the user's personal accounts or cookies. Never touch login-only or private data (DMs, private groups or accounts, follower lists, anything behind a login wall). Never post, like, follow or perform any other write action.
- "Guest" identifiers are fine: anonymous device or session tokens that a site gives every logged-out visitor (B站 buvid3, 抖音 ttwid, a 小红书 guest session).
- Free methods go first, in the order listed below. BeatAPI is called only when the user has set `BEATAPI_API_KEY` and you pass `--fallback-beatapi`. Never print or echo the key.
- If a free method fails and the user has no `BEATAPI_API_KEY` yet, tell them exactly which capability needs the paid fallback (the name the script prints) and send them the sign-up and key steps from section 4b. In Grok Bot, offer a secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY`. Never ask for the key in plain chat, and never run paid calls without their go-ahead.
- Download only short samples of large media unless the user asks for the full file (`--max-mb`).

## 1. Install and run
Code lives in `/workspace/omni-scraper`. If it does not exist, rebuild it from section 5.
```bash
sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg
cd /workspace/omni-scraper && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python scrape.py "<url>" --out out/<name> [--with-media] [--with-comments] [--transcribe] [--max-mb 60] [--search KEYWORD] [--fallback-beatapi]
```
- The platform is detected from the URL. Each run writes `content.md` and `meta.json` plus any media files. `--transcribe` requires `--with-media`.
- The log shows `[OK ]` or `[FAIL]` for every method tried. If all free methods fail, it prints `>> '<cap>' failed with all free methods -> paid fallback: BeatAPI capability data:...`. Report that capability name to the user.
- Regression check: `tests/run_regression.sh --with-media --max-mb 8 --max-images 3`.

## 2. Capability matrix (datacenter IP, logged out)
✅ free and tested, 🟡 free but needs residential IP/guest cookie/self-hosting, 🅱️ BeatAPI fallback (🅱️* generic page reader `data:web.read` only), – n/a.

| Platform | Text | Author | Stats | Images | Video (no watermark) | Audio | Subtitles | Comments | Profile/list | Search |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YouTube | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ (🅱️ captions) | ✅ | 🟡 (🅱️) | 🟡 (🅱️) |
| B站 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ DASH | ✅ | ✅ whisper | ✅ guest | 🟡 wbi | 🟡 wbi |
| X | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🅱️ | ✅ timeline | 🅱️ |
| 公众号 | ✅ | ✅ | 🅱️ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | ✅ | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🟡 |
| 抖音 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ whisper | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🅱️ |
| 小红书 | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🟡 | 🟡 | 🟡 | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🅱️ |
| TikTok | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ whisper | 🅱️ | 🟡 | 🅱️ |
| Instagram | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 ~853px | 🟡 | 🟡 | – | ✅ few (🅱️) | 🅱️ | 🅱️ |
| Facebook | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ frame | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🅱️* | 🅱️* | 🅱️* |
| Threads | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | 🟡 (🅱️) | ✅ (🅱️) | 🅱️ |
| LinkedIn | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ JSON-LD (🅱️) | 🟡 (🅱️) | 🅱️ jobs |
| Reddit | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ | ✅ RSS | 🟡 (🅱️) |
| Pinterest | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | 🅱️* | 🟡 | 🅱️* |
| Telegram | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | – | ✅ | 🅱️ |
| Medium | ✅ | ✅ | 🅱️* | ✅ | – | – | – | 🅱️* | ✅ RSS | 🟡 |
| Substack | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | – | 🟡 | – | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 |
| Bluesky | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 | – | – | ✅ | ✅ | 🟡 |

## 3. Free method chains
- YouTube: yt-dlp `-j` (+`getcomments`); auto subtitles from `automatic_captions` vtt; audio `yt-dlp -x`.
- B站: guest buvid3/4 from `api.bilibili.com/x/frontend/finger/spi`, UA + Referer bilibili.com; `x/web-interface/wbi/view?bvid=` → `view` → `__INITIAL_STATE__` → yt-dlp; comments `x/v2/reply?type=1&oid=<aid>&sort=1`; DASH via `x/player/playurl?fnval=16`, merge with ffmpeg; transcripts via faster-whisper.
- X: `cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=<id>&token=4`; profile `syndication.twitter.com/srv/timeline-profile/screen-name/<user>` (`__NEXT_DATA__`).
- 公众号: parse `#js_content`, `og:title`, `var nickname`, `var ct`, images `data-src`.
- 抖音: guest ttwid (POST `ttwid.bytedance.com/ttwid/union/register/`); `iesdouyin.com/share/video/<id>/` with Android UA, parse `_ROUTER_DATA`; replace `playwm`→`play` for no-watermark mp4; fallback Googlebot UA on `douyin.com/video/<id>`.
- 小红书: `xhshow` signer for guest `web_session`; signed homefeed/feed with xsec_token; originals via `ci.xiaohongshu.com/<trace>?imageView2/format/jpg`; datacenter IPs get 461 → residential IP or BeatAPI.
- TikTok: yt-dlp, oEmbed fallback. Instagram: yt-dlp `--ignore-no-formats-error`. Facebook: yt-dlp + Googlebot UA page. Threads: Googlebot/facebookexternalhit UA, og + SSR JSON. LinkedIn: JSON-LD on logged-out post/company pages. Reddit: `.json` → `.rss` → arctic-shift. Pinterest: `gallery-dl -j`, oEmbed. Telegram: `t.me/s/<channel>`. Medium: `/feed/@user`. Substack: `/api/v1/posts/<slug>`, comments API. Bluesky: `public.api.bsky.app/xrpc/`. Other: yt-dlp generic, OpenGraph.
- Transcripts: faster-whisper (CPU int8, small+ for Chinese) on 16 kHz PCM numpy arrays.

## 4. Datacenter IP limits
B站 412, Reddit 403, 小红书 461, YouTube subtitles 429, Instagram profiles 401. Try a residential IP before paying. Paid fallback only when all free methods failed and the user agreed.

## 4b. Paid fallback: BeatAPI
Only with `--fallback-beatapi` and `BEATAPI_API_KEY` set. References (check with `python beatapi.py check`; `find`, `inspect` for schemas):
- 抖音: `data:douyin.app.v3.fetch_one_video`, `fetch_video_comments`, `data:douyin.web.handler_user_profile`, `fetch_user_post_videos`, `data:douyin.app.v3.open_douyin_app_to_keyword_search`
- 小红书: `data:xiaohongshu.web_v3.fetch_note_detail`, `data:xiaohongshu.app_v2.get_note_comments`, `web_v3.fetch_user_info`, `app_v2.get_user_posted_notes`, `app_v2.search_notes`
- TikTok: `data:tiktok.app.v3.fetch_video_comments`, `data:tiktok.web.fetch_user_profile`, `fetch_user_post`, `app.v3.fetch_general_search_result`
- Instagram: `data:instagram.v2.fetch_post_comments`, `fetch_user_posts`, `general_search`
- X: `data:twitter.web.fetch_post_comments`, `fetch_user_post_tweet`, `fetch_search_timeline`
- YouTube: `data:youtube.web_v2.get_video_comments`, `get_video_captions`, `get_channel_videos`, `get_general_search`
- B站: `data:bilibili.web.fetch_video_comments`, `fetch_user_post_videos`, `fetch_general_search`
- 公众号: `data:wechat_mp.v2.fetch_article_detail_h5`, `fetch_article_stats`, `fetch_article_comments`, `fetch_account_articles`
- Threads: `data:threads.web.fetch_post_detail_v2`, `fetch_user_info`, `fetch_user_posts`, `search_recent`
- LinkedIn: `data:linkedin.web_v2.get_post_detail`, `get_post_comments`, `get_user_profile`, `get_user_posts`, `get_company_profile`, `get_company_posts`, `get_job_detail`, `search_jobs`
- Reddit: `data:reddit.app.fetch_dynamic_search`
- Facebook, Pinterest, Medium, other: `data:web.read`
Two-step inputs via `BEATAPI_INPUT` JSON; override with `BEATAPI_REF_<PLATFORM>_<CAP>`.

Setup: sign up https://beatapi.io/sign-up; create key https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys (shown once); top up https://beatapi.io/dashboard/billing; pricing https://beatapi.io/pricing; docs https://docs.beatapi.io/quick-guide. Provide the key via a Grok Bot secret-input card for `BEATAPI_API_KEY`, or locally `read -rsp "BeatAPI API key: " BEATAPI_API_KEY && export BEATAPI_API_KEY`. Never print or commit it.

中文简版：默认免费；需要兜底时注册 https://beatapi.io/sign-up ，在 https://beatapi.io/dashboard/apikeys 创建 key，用密钥卡片填入 `BEATAPI_API_KEY`。

## 5. Rebuilding /workspace/omni-scraper (MIT)
- `requirements.txt`: requests, yt-dlp, gallery-dl, xhshow, numpy, faster-whisper.
- `core.py`: UA constants; `Result` object; `attempt(res, capability, [(name, fn)…])` logging OK/FAIL and adding to `needs_beatapi`; yt-dlp/download/ffmpeg/whisper helpers; `write_outputs` (content.md, meta.json).
- `platforms/<name>.py` with `MATCH` + `scrape(res, opts)` per section 3; `detect(url)` in `__init__.py`.
- `scrape.py`: argparse flags above; media download; BeatAPI hint or `beatapi.run`.
- `beatapi.py`: `POST /v1/capabilities/search|inspect|run` at `https://api.beatapi.io` with `Authorization: Bearer $BEATAPI_API_KEY`, `{reference, operation:"start", input, view:"full"}`; never log the key.
- `tests/regression_urls.txt` (well-known large accounts) and `tests/run_regression.sh` (`< /dev/null`).
